messages.content: You are planning a sequence of ordinary, mundane public social-media posts for one fictional author. You do not write the posts; you invent the concrete, small, specific everyday occasions behind them. Output strict JSON only.

Author profile:
- płeć gramatyczna: mężczyzna (formy męskie)
- zajęcie i rytm dnia: Jest na emeryturze w Oświęcimiu; rano załatwia sprawunki, a pisze po podwieczorku.
- zainteresowania: renowacja taboretów, krzyżówki panoramiczne, domowe konfitury
- lokalny punkt odniesienia: kiosk przy ulicy Nojego w Oświęcimiu
- aktualna sytuacja życiowa: Odnawia dwa stare taborety i szuka pasującej tkaniny na siedziska.
- sposób pisania: zdania: long run-on; interpunkcja: wielokropki i średniki; wielkie litery: random caps for emphasis; literówki: rare; skróty: none; emoji: rare
- tik językowy: dopowiada „i to jest cała sztuka”

For each of the 17 topic prompts below, invent ONE concrete, specific, small occasion from this person's life that would make them post (not a generic statement about the topic: a particular thing that happened, with at most one small detail a real person would mention - sometimes a product name, sometimes a number or price, sometimes a place, occasionally a time; many occasions need no such detail at all). Vary mood (bored, amused, tired, pleased, mildly annoyed, neutral, curious), vary how the post starts (mid-thought, a question, a one-word reaction, a fact, a quote of what someone said), and decide whether the verbal tic appears (at most in a third of posts). Occasions must not involve conflict with identifiable people, politics, crime, security, violence, or protected characteristics.

Topic prompts:
1. jedzenie i gotowanie - śniadanie w biegu (late night, Monday)
2. gry i seriale - mobilna gra, uzależnienie żartem (morning commute, Tuesday)
3. komunikacja i dojazdy - parking, brak miejsc (morning commute, Thursday)
4. zakupy i ceny - nowe buty / kurtka (lunch break, Thursday)
5. zdrowie i sen - kawa i sen, ironicznie (late night, Thursday)
6. sport - siłownia, nowy rekord (late morning, Sunday)
7. sport - bieganie, pierwsza 5/10 km (late night, Monday)
8. zakupy i ceny - promocja, zakup impulsywny (early morning, Friday)
9. technologia i sprzęt - backup, utracone zdjęcia (early morning, Tuesday)
10. zwierzęta - zwierzę zniszczyło coś (evening, Tuesday)
11. komunikacja i dojazdy - kontrola biletów (evening, Wednesday)
12. zdrowie i sen - niewyspanie (late morning, Friday)
13. komunikacja i dojazdy - spóźniony autobus / tramwaj (lunch break, Tuesday)
14. technologia i sprzęt - problem z wifi (lunch break, Thursday)
15. drobne narzekanie na usługi - serwis samochodu (early morning, Tuesday)
16. pogoda - wiatr, burza (late morning, Thursday)
17. gry i seriale - maraton serialu, zarwana noc (afternoon, Monday)

Return a JSON array of 17 objects, in order, each with:
- "occasion": one or two sentences in Polish, concrete
- "mood": one word in English
- "opener": one of "mid-thought", "question", "one-word reaction", "plain fact", "reported speech", "complaint", "list of two things"
- "length_words": integer between 8 and 50, varied across the set (some very short)
- "tic_fires": true or false
